1301.author: HongyeZhou
1301.body:
## Problem

`createArtifactVersion` numbered a new version as `artifact.currentVersion + 1` (`services/api/src/store.ts`). The pointer was the only source of truth, so a catalogue where it lagged behind the versions on disk (written by an older build, restored, or merged by hand) handed out a number that already existed. Two versions of one Artifact then both read as "v3", which leaves the version list, `latestReportVersion`, research-snapshot copies and every reference that pins `(artifactId, version)` ambiguous.

## Change

- `createArtifactVersion` allocates `max(highest stored version, artifact.currentVersion) + 1`, so a number is never reused even when the pointer lags.
- Before appending, the allocated number is checked against the catalogue; a collision throws `ARTIFACT_VERSION_DUPLICATE`, in the same style as the existing `ARTIFACT_VERSION_CONFLICT`, so a broken catalogue fails loudly instead of silently duplicating a number.
- `load()` repairs a catalogue that already holds duplicates: within one Artifact the first number in `(createdAt, id)` order is kept and every later collision moves to a free number above that Artifact's highest one, and `currentVersion` is lifted to the repaired maximum. The existing migration save persists the repair.

I renumbered on load instead of refusing to load: the issue leaves that sub-question to the maintainer, and a refusal would strand every session whose catalogue already has such a version. No version ID changes, so dependencies and references are untouched.

## Tests

`services/api/src/store.test.ts`:

- `Artifact versions are numbered above the stored versions, not from a stale currentVersion pointer` writes `currentVersion: 0` into the persisted catalogue after two versions exist and expects the next allocation to be `3`.
- `a catalog holding duplicate Artifact version numbers is renumbered on load` writes two versions under number `1`, expects `[1, 2]` after `load()`, the same numbers on a second load, and the next allocation to be `3`.

Both fail on the unmodified `store.ts` (`1 !== 3` for the first, duplicate numbers for the second).

## Verification

- `pnpm ci:l1` — PASS, planned 4 / passed 4 / failed 0
- `node --import tsx --test src/store.test.ts` in `services/api` — 133 tests, 133 pass, 0 fail
- The full `services/api` suite in the same worktree is 2461 pass / 20 fail, and none of the failures touch Artifact versioning: they need `services/paper/.venv`, the `sciencediscovery_evolve` package or a user namespace, none of which exist in this worktree, and the two `API runs ... subagent` cases fail the same way on the untouched base `bbdbdd5c`.
- No user-visible surface changes, so no screenshots apply.

Fixes #1300
